body:
Follow-up of #1883 (PR for Waterjet Profile).

## Problem

`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` has a "Plasma Profile workflow" section. It has no section for the new Waterjet Profile. An agent that drives CamCraft through MCP cannot find the waterjet steps or the parameter keys.

## Wanted

Add a "Waterjet Profile workflow (#1883)" section before the plasma section. It says:

- There is no built-in waterjet. Mount a `kind: "waterjet"` `.mch` file with `load_machine { "path": ... }`.
- Add a nozzle with `add_tool { "name": "Nozzle", "definition": { ..., "kind": "waterjet", "diameter": <kerf>, "rpm": 0 } }`. Its diameter is the kerf width.
- `add_operation { "kind": "Waterjet Profile", ... }` with the params `kerf`, `control_comp`, `reversed`, `lead` (`arc` / `straight`), `lead_in`, `lead_out`, `open_side` (`center` / `left` / `right`), `tabs` (`count`, `width`, `at`), `feed`, `pierce_time`, `abrasive_delay`, `linearize`.
- Pierce time and abrasive delay are in the path notes only until #1882. No post serves a waterjet yet.

`crates/app/tests/mcp_waterjet.rs` pins this workflow.

This is a process-file change: the PR body has the line `Process change: yes`.
